sheets.barnaby: Photorealistic horizontal character reference photograph of one fictional man, shown twice side by side at the same size from the waist up: facing the lens on the left half, and turned toward the right of the frame on the right half. A cheerful 70-year-old with messy curly silver-white hair, a clean-shaven round face and a clean-shaven upper lip, thick black square-rimmed glasses, a mustard-yellow wool cardigan over a blue checked shirt, and a stubby pencil tucked behind his right ear. Friendly closed-mouth expression. Plain light grey studio background with nothing else in the image, the two views separated only by empty grey space, soft even studio light, natural skin.
sheets.ambrose: Photorealistic horizontal character reference photograph of one fictional man, shown twice side by side at the same size from the waist up: facing the lens on the right half, and turned toward the left of the frame on the left half. A lean, proud 65-year-old with a long narrow face, a long wavy silver wig falling past his shoulders, a long dark brown late-17th-century coat and a white linen cravat. Calm closed-mouth expression, chin slightly raised. Plain light grey studio background with nothing else in the image, the two views separated only by empty grey space, soft even studio light, natural skin.

backgrounds.orchard: Photorealistic horizontal film still of an empty old English apple orchard at golden evening. Eye-level camera, with the horizon about two-thirds of the way up the frame. Untouched open grass below it, rows of apple trees heavy with red apples in the background, slightly out of focus. Soft low sunlight from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A calm, empty orchard.
backgrounds.moon: Photorealistic horizontal film still of the empty grey dusty surface of the Moon. Eye-level camera, with the horizon about two-thirds of the way up the frame. An undisturbed expanse of flat grey dust below it, a pure black sky, the blue Earth small, just above the horizon near the center of the frame. Low white sunlight from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural film look. A silent, empty lunar plain.
